public_rationale: On the ordinary reading that ChatGPT means OpenAI's ChatGPT-driven business losing billions annually, the claim is supported. [CNBC's completed-year report](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/06/09/openai-hits-10-billion-in-annualized-revenue-fueled-by-chatgpt-growth.html) puts the 2024 loss at about $5 billion. The earlier forecast is context only. The smaller first-half cash-burn figure measures something different and does not overturn the annual loss finding.
limitations: The finding relies on financial journalism because underlying company statements were not obtained.
It supports an approximate annual business loss, not a precise audited net-income or cash-flow figure.
The result depends on the disclosed reading of ChatGPT as OpenAI's business and burns as financial losses.
